prototypes.name: dew
prototypes.prompt: Generate ONE new transparent-background game aura sprite for a monochrome e-ink chibi RPG. The attached character is ONLY a style/stroke reference: do NOT include the character, a person, clothing, text, border, UI, ground or background. Portrait composition, roughly 192x224 logical pixel art enlarged cleanly. REDESIGN the artwork from scratch with recognizable clear silhouettes; do not skeletonize, trace into wire shapes, or use hairline contours. Pure black and opaque white interiors, actual transparent exterior, no gray, dithering or texture. Consistent crisp outline about TWO logical pixels at 192px width, matching the attached chibi character's outlines. Low-level DEW aura: exactly FOUR cute water droplets with pointed tips and rounded bottoms, each a coherent filled white shape with a clean black outline and one tiny black accent. Place them at the four outer corners of an invisible vertical oval, around x12%/88%, y25%/75%; droplets about15% of full canvas height. Leave the center60%width and central70%height completely transparent for a full body avatar. Keep every droplet complete, simple, balanced and comfortably inside image edges. No additional little particles, frames or scenery. Distinct droplets must retain their teardrop form at small screen size.

prototypes.name: middle
prototypes.prompt: Generate ONE new transparent-background magical aura sprite for a monochrome e-ink chibi RPG. The attached character is ONLY a style/stroke reference; do NOT draw the character, a face, clothing, UI, text, ground or background. Portrait composition, a clean 192x224 logical pixel-art design enlarged with crisp chunky pixel edges. Pure black plus opaque white within illustrated shapes, actual transparent exterior. No grayscale, dithering, realistic effects, skeletonized contours or thin wire drawings. Use a consistent TWO logical pixel black outline at192px width, comparable to the reference's costume. Mid-level READING MAGIC aura: two broad curved ribbons of wind and THREE tiny floating open-book/page symbols arranged along the outside of a vertical oval, with four small four-point stars. The central60% width and70%height must remain completely transparent for the whole avatar. Curves and book pages should have clean confident recognizable cartoon forms with white fill, small black accents and very few interior lines, clearly legible when reduced to192x224. Symmetric balanced visual weight, complete shapes with margin at all edges. No drawn oval border; the objects imply the aura's perimeter.

prototypes.name: divine
prototypes.prompt: Generate ONE new transparent-background DIVINE RADIANCE aura sprite for a monochrome e-ink chibi RPG. The attached character is ONLY a style and stroke reference; do NOT include the character, people, clothing, text, UI, ground or background. Portrait composition at roughly192x224 logical pixel-art resolution, enlarged crisply. This is a complete fresh redesign with strong recognizable cartoon silhouettes, NOT skeletonized outlines or a web of thin wires. Pure black and opaque white illustrated shapes, genuine transparent exterior. No gray, dithering, textures, realistic feather shading or hundreds of tiny marks. Consistent clean TWO logical pixel black outlines at192px width, matching the reference's costume. Two big symmetric angel wings frame an EMPTY central body-shaped window: each wing has only SIX broad rounded pointed feathers, simple white surfaces with short black shadow accents and at most one interior detail per feather. Wings sweep outward then downward without crossing the central60%width/70%height avatar window. THREE simple separated elliptical halos sit above that empty central space; add four clear four-point stars around the outside, with one star below. Maximum level appearance, elegant and powerful but readable small. The whole aura surrounds an absent avatar; leave the center transparent. Keep all feathers, halos and stars complete with safe outer margins. No external rectangular/oval frame.
